run_locate3d_inference: run inference on a featurized pointcloud with a text caption using the Locate3D model
load_locate3d_model: load a pretrained Locate3D model from the facebook/locate-3d-plus checkpoint
create_locate3d_dataset: create a Locate3DDataset with annotation paths and data directory configurations for ScanNet, ScanNet++, and ARKitScenes
access_dataset_sample: access a specific sample from the Locate3DDataset by index to retrieve featurized pointcloud and language data
downsample_pointcloud: downsample a featurized sensor pointcloud to a target number of points for faster inference
